source.note: External files are replaced wholesale on a re-sync and never edited here. Night values: tokens.css [data-theme=night]. The two band grounds and on-tint text tokens: site.css :root, sandal re-declared for Night. Hero colours: bundle.css --hero-* variables.
source.deviation: The DS specifies two dark sanctum zones (hero and Live darshan); Venkat overrode this for the Day theme on 2026-10-23 (M2.4). M2.5 reduced the band grounds to two. M2.6: the DS Sannidhi hero (ivory sanctum by day, dark sanctum by night), with the photo as a CSS background by theme, a 29svh phone photo, and from 1100px the photo ending above the day line, capped at 1600px and centred. Live darshan stays ivory in both themes.

sanctum.use: The Night hero's ground (--hero-bg) and the Night Live poster strip; no band uses it.

band-ivory.use: The hero by day, Live darshan, Upcoming events (kolam), footer (kolam and toran).

band-sandal.use: Build Baba's temple, Ways to give, Plan your visit (class .sd-band--sunken).

muted-on-tint.use: Replaces --ink-muted on .sd-band--sunken only; min text contrast on a band ground 5.54:1 Day, 5.91:1 Night.

twitch.use: Open on Twitch button only; the one deliberate off-palette colour and the one deliberate literal colour in the page layer (third-party brand). White label 4.65:1.

action-sanctum.use: The Night hero's glow button, with dark text #1A110C.

display-lg.purpose: Hero H1 from 1100px; once per page, in --hero-ink.

display.purpose: Hero H1 on phones; grows fluidly to display-lg.

vachan.purpose: Baba's words, italic, heading colour on the ivory Live darshan band.

event-feature-title.purpose: The featured event's title only; 34px from 900px.

time.purpose: Aarti times and amounts, tabular lining numerals.

shadows.name: shadow-soft
shadows.purpose: Cards and the selected segment at rest.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: The day line, hovered cards, menus.

shadows.name: shadow-glow
shadows.purpose: Lamp light: primary hover, next and today rings.

shadows.name: doorway-ring
shadows.purpose: The Darbar doorway around wide media; --frame-ground is the band's ground.

shadows.name: gold-hairline
shadows.purpose: A resting featured event and the Live darshan frame (inset form there); the flyer stage uses inset 0 0 0 1px var(--gold).

motion.name: dur-calm
motion.purpose: Section fade on scroll; Baba's words crossfade.

motion.name: dur-flicker
motion.purpose: Lit flame flicker while an aarti is live.

motion.name: day-line-in
motion.purpose: Day line draws once on load; none under reduced motion.

motion.name: breathe-glow
motion.purpose: The DS breathing glow behind Baba in the Night hero only; none under reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: bp-tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Two columns, hero buttons show, action bar hides, hero photo grows to min(40svh, 440px).

breakpoints.name: wide-layout
breakpoints.purpose: Wide day line, seven-arch week, featured event splits.

breakpoints.name: bp-wide-nav
breakpoints.purpose: Hero full-bleed with copy left, photo above the day line and capped at 1600px; full header nav; three events across.

breakpoints.name: hero-veil
breakpoints.purpose: Hero photo side edges veiled in --hero-bg (4% each side).

radii.name: framed-media
radii.purpose: Posters and images inside a frame; the DS sanctum frame's inner radius (radius-md less the 4px inset).

radii.name: week-tile-arch
radii.purpose: Whole day tile in the week of arches, from 900px.

radii.name: portrait-flyer-arch
radii.purpose: Portrait event flyers (taller than 1.2:1), hugging the image width.

heroImages.method: CSS background on div.sd-sannidhi__img chosen by [data-theme] and width; never <picture> media (it follows the device, not the switch). An inline script in index.astro preloads the same file with the same media queries.
heroImages.from1100: bottom: var(--today-overlap) with a one-layer bottom fade (mask); width min(100%, 1600px), margin 0 auto; from 1601px an ::after veil in var(--hero-bg), 4% each side, not a second mask layer (composited mask layers leave a hairline).
heroImages.kolam: div.sd-kolam.sd-sannidhi__kolam on the open ground: below the photo on phones; left half from 1100px, masked out from 55%.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "Lamp light in the sanctum"**

The site reads like a small mandir at the hour of aarti: two grounds from the temple's own materials (kafni ivory and chandan with gold), sindoor headings, Baba's murti full-bleed in the sanctum hero, and light only where something is happening now or next. Everything at rest stays calm and warm; the lit flame, the glow, the saffron thread mark the active moment. Two themes, Day (Kakad) and Night (Shej), share every rule. Day has no dark section: the hero is an ivory sanctum, Baba lifted onto ivory with a marigold glow and a gold halo baked into the photograph. In Night the hero is the DS dark sanctum with its breathing glow, and the two grounds below become warm darks.

Density is generous and elder-first: 18px body, 48px touch targets, one column on phones and short split layouts on desktop. Devotional devices come from the temple itself and are rationed: the toran garland twice a page (hero top, footer top), the dhuni mark (Dwarkamai arch, crossed logs, flame) on every section head, Dwarkamai arches on tall things, the Darbar doorway around wide media (the tour video, the Visit stage photo, landscape flyers), the DS kolam on three grounds (the hero's open ground, Events, footer) and a kolam on the Visit doorstep, and one gold line drawing (the thali) on the page.

Page order and grounds: hero and day line (ivory sanctum by day, dark sanctum by night, kolam on the open ground), Build Baba's temple (gold sandal), Live darshan and Baba's words (ivory), Ways to give (gold sandal), Upcoming events (ivory, with kolam), Plan your visit (gold sandal), footer (ivory, with kolam and toran). Two grounds strictly alternate from hero to footer, so every neighbour differs in value (1.36:1 in Day, 1.54:1 in Night). Contrast between bands comes from the ground itself, not from seam friezes.
keyCharacteristics: Light marks only the active: next aarti, next event, now on the day line, today in the week, the selected choice.
Nothing is ever placed over Baba's murti, the day line included; text and controls sit beside or below his photograph.
One display serif weight (Tiro 400) for headings and Baba's words; Anek for everything read or pressed.
Arches for tall things, the doorway for wide media, pills and 16px holds; no sharp corners.
Motion is feedback, state and lamp light only, and stops under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Lamp Light Rule
rules.body: Saffron glow, glow-soft and the lit flame belong only to what is now, next, today or selected. A resting element never glows. The ambient lights belong to the sanctum and stay there: a faint glow-soft radial wash behind the appeal's content, the marigold glow and gold halo baked into the Day hero photographs, and the DS breathing glow behind Baba in the Night hero (6s, still under reduced motion). The hero's glow button is the DS lamp-lit action: Watch live takes it within the soon window of an aarti or while live (live.ts), Get directions otherwise.

rules.name: The Value Step Rule
rules.body: Two grounds alternate strictly from hero to footer: hero (ivory sanctum, or the dark sanctum by night), sandal, ivory, sandal, ivory, sandal, ivory. Every neighbour differs in value (1.36:1 Day, 1.54:1 Night) and never only in hue. A new band takes whichever of the two keeps the alternation; no third ground, no dark ground below the hero, and none in the hero by day.

rules.name: The Words First Rule
rules.body: Status (open, closed, live, soon) is always written; colour and dots only repeat it.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Tiro is only ever 400; emphasis comes from size and colour, never bold serif.

rules.name: The Mantra Rule
rules.body: The hero's line above the H1 is the DS Devanagari devotional mantra ("श्रद्धा · सबुरी", Tiro 19px, 22px from 1100px, in --hero-kicker: link by day, gold-light by night), set between two short rules on phones and followed by one from 1100px. It is not an English eyebrow. Section heads carry the dhuni mark, not a text label; a section headed by its own drawing (Ways to give, the thali) drops the mark.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted ink by day and black by night, never grey, never hard offset.

rules.name: The Tall Arch Rule
rules.body: The Dwarkamai arch (pill top, radius-sm or radius-md foot) frames only tall things: icon and date tiles, the week's day tiles (phones: a 56px by 72px pill-top name tile; from 900px the whole day tile, 50% 50% 16px 16px / 80px 80px 16px 16px) and portrait event flyers (pill top hugging the image's own width, chosen when the image is taller than 1.2:1). Wide media never take the arch.

dos: Do take every value from tokens.css or the band tokens mixed from it in site.css; the one deliberate literal colour in the page layer is Twitch purple.
Do keep light on the active: one next aarti, one next event, one lamp at now, one today.
Do hang the toran at most twice a page (hero top, footer top).

Do alternate the two grounds from hero to footer (hero ivory or sanctum, then sandal, ivory, sandal, ivory, sandal, ivory), and re-point muted text and links to the on-tint steps on every sandal band.
Do set the hero photo as a CSS background chosen by [data-theme] and width, and preload the same file with the same media queries.
Do put wide media in the Darbar doorway and keep the arch for tall things; let the doorway's ring gap follow the band.
Do keep 48px touch targets and 18px body in both themes, and test Day and Night.
Do re-sync the design system by replacing tokens.json, tokens.css and bundle.css wholesale, then fix the page layer.
donts: Don't place text, controls, menus or the day line over Baba's murti; the hero photo ends above the day line and the kolam fades before him.
Don't use or media for the hero photo: it follows the device, not the Day/Night switch.
Don't use stock, painted or AI images of Baba; only the Darbar's own photographs and the DS's light treatments of them.
